policies.title: Hours of Operation
policies.content: We're open Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Doors open at 7:00 AM sharp — early drop-off is not available. Pickup by 6:00 PM.

policies.title: Illness & Exclusion Policy
policies.content: Children with a fever of 100.4°F or higher, vomiting, diarrhea, or an undiagnosed rash must stay home. Your child can return once they've been symptom-free for 24 hours without medication. After an absence of 3 or more days, please bring a doctor's note.

policies.title: Tuition Rates
policies.content: Monthly tuition rates are based on classroom placement as of September 1st. Infant (6 weeks-12 months): $2,200 | Toddler (1-2 years): $1,900 | Preschool (3 years): $1,600 | Pre-K (4-5 years): $1,400. Important: if your child is 4 years old, placement in either Preschool ($1,600) or Pre-K ($1,400) depends on classroom assignment — the enrollment coordinator can confirm. A 10% sibling discount applies. Tuition is due on the 1st with a $50 late fee after the 5th.

policies.title: Billing Questions & Disputes
policies.content: For billing questions or to dispute a charge, please contact our administrative office directly. Billing matters cannot be resolved over chat.
policies.escalation_contact: Office Manager Linda Park at billing@sunshineelc.com or (206) 555-0124

policies.title: Meals & Lunch Program
policies.content: All meals are included in tuition. We provide breakfast at 8:00 AM, lunch at 12:00 PM, and an afternoon snack at 3:00 PM. You do not need to pack food — ever. If you forgot to pack lunch, no worries: your child will be fed the same meal as everyone else.

policies.title: Authorized Pickup
policies.content: Only adults listed on your authorized pickup form may collect your child. Photo ID is required for anyone not recognized by staff. To add or remove someone from your authorized list, the primary account holder must update the form in person.
policies.escalation_contact: Front desk staff in person, or call (206) 555-0123

policies.title: Custody & Court Orders
policies.content: We follow court custody orders exactly as written. Any change requires the director in person — it cannot be handled over chat or phone. If you have a new or updated court order, bring the original document to Director Maria Torres.

policies.title: Tours & Enrollment
policies.content: We are currently accepting enrollments for Fall 2026. Tours are available Tuesday and Thursday at 10:00 AM. To schedule a tour call (206) 555-0123 or email info@sunshineelc.com. Infant spots are limited and a waitlist is available.

policies.title: Late Pickup Policy
policies.content: Pickup is by 6:00 PM. A $1 per minute fee applies starting at 6:01 PM. After 6:30 PM with no contact, we are required by state licensing to begin emergency procedures. Please call us immediately if you will be late.

policies.title: Medication Administration
policies.content: Staff can administer prescription medication with a completed Medication Authorization Form signed by a parent and physician. We do not administer over-the-counter medication unless prescribed.

policies.title: Food Allergies
policies.content: We take food allergies seriously. All allergies must be documented in writing before your child's first day. Life-threatening allergies require an EpiPen on file and a signed Emergency Action Plan.

policies.title: Incidents & Biting Policy
policies.content: If your child is involved in a biting incident, you will receive a written incident report at pickup. We do not share the name of the other child involved. Our teachers use developmentally appropriate strategies to address biting.

policies.title: What to Pack
policies.content: Please pack one complete change of clothes labeled with your child's name. You do not need to pack food, drinks, or diapers — all are provided.

policies.title: Withdrawal & Notice Period
policies.content: We require 30 days written notice before withdrawing your child. Notice must be submitted in writing via email to info@sunshineelc.com. Tuition is due for the full 30-day notice period regardless of attendance.

policies.title: Holiday Closures
policies.content: We close on all federal holidays. We also close December 24th through January 1st for winter break. Closure dates are posted in the parent app by October 1st each year.

policies.title: Weather & Emergency Closures
policies.content: If we need to close due to weather or an emergency, we notify all families by 6:00 AM via the parent app and email. Please check the app before calling the center on weather days.
